records.text: In the Posobiec interview clip, Zacharia said she was offered a job in Zhonglun Law Firm’s international practice division, with four associates under a senior partner handling its English-language side, and said, “There’s no Chinese bar.”
records.speaker: Katie Zacharia

appearances.snippet: I was offered a job in an international practice division of a Chinese law firm called Zhonglun Law Firm. ... And the international practice were four associates under a senior partner and we worked the international side, the English language side, and we had a Chinese counterpart that was there. There's no Chinese bar.

records.text: In the Posobiec interview clip, Zacharia said her law degree provided the necessary credentials for multimillion-dollar cross-border shareholder agreements and transactions and that she received glowing senior-partner recommendations.
records.speaker: Katie Zacharia

appearances.snippet: I had enough credentials, which was my law degree, to be able to do this practice and these are multi-million dollar. ... our shareholders agreements and transactions that were cross border and there I had all the necessary requirements to do that and I was able to do it effectively and well and had glowing recommendations from the senior partner who oversaw my time there.
